items.title: Evaluation of Costal Cartilage Calcification Using Plain Radiographic Images
items.fact_zh: 183例鼻整形1098段肋软骨，平片钙化检出54.1%；重度钙化高峰在40–49岁。
items.take_zh: 术前一张肋骨平片能少一次台上意外；40多岁女性重度钙化风险最高，别只按年龄想当然。
items.scene_zh: 先拍个肋骨平片，别等上台才发现软骨钙化。
items.fact_en: In 183 rhinoplasty patients (1,098 rib segments), plain radiographs detected costal cartilage calcification in 54.1%, with severe calcification peaking at age 40-49 (25.8%).
items.take_en: A routine rib series avoids intraoperative surprises; women in their 40s carry the highest risk of severe calcification, not the oldest patients.

items.title: Does Previous Septoplasty Affect Rhinoplasty Outcomes? A Comparative Analysis of Functional, Psychological and Self-Assessment Measures
items.fact_zh: 75例鼻中隔鼻整形，27例曾做鼻中隔成形；术后6个月外观满意度更低，功能与生活质量仍改善。
items.take_zh: 有鼻中隔手术史的，外观预期要提前压低；功能该做还得做，别因既往史劝退。
items.scene_zh: 做过鼻中隔的，外观别按初鼻承诺，功能改善还是稳的。
items.fact_en: Among 75 rhinoseptoplasty patients, 27 (36%) had prior septoplasty and reported lower cosmetic satisfaction at 1 and 6 months, although nasal function and quality of life improved significantly.
items.take_en: Lower the aesthetic expectation for prior-septoplasty patients, but do not let surgical history discourage a functionally indicated procedure.

items.title: The L-Shaped Lateral Crural Graft: A Single-Graft Technique for the Correction of Alar Concavity and Nasal Valve Insufficiency
items.fact_zh: 12例二次鼻整形用L形侧鼻翼软骨移植，随访9.5个月，通气改善、无感染或外露。
items.take_zh: 单移植物同时撑侧鼻翼和鼻阀，思路漂亮；但只有12例、无对照，先用于选择好的二次病例。
items.scene_zh: 二次鼻翼塌的，可以考虑一块L形肋软骨同时解决功能和外形。
items.fact_en: In 12 revision rhinoplasty patients, a single L-shaped costal cartilage graft improved nasal breathing and alar contour over a mean 9.5 months, with no infection, exposure, warping, or resorption.
items.take_en: One graft addressing both lateral crural support and the nasal valve is elegant, but 12 uncontrolled cases make it an option for selected revisions, not a new standard.

items.title: Comparative Vector Analysis in Deep Plane Rhytidectomy: Evaluating Combined Horizontal and Oblique SMAS Fixation Strategies in Face and Neck Lifting
items.fact_zh: 80例深层除皱：面部斜向+颈部水平固定，FACE-Q 88.4、WSRS改善2.4分，优于其余组合。
items.take_zh: 面颈别用同一个矢量：面斜拉、颈水平收，主观客观都更好；回顾性单中心，先学思路。
items.scene_zh: 面往斜上提，脖子往水平收，别一根线拉到底。
items.fact_en: In 80 deep-plane facelifts, oblique facial plus horizontal neck fixation scored highest (FACE-Q 88.4; WSRS improvement 2.4 points) versus three other vector combinations.
items.take_en: Use different vectors for face and neck; the retrospective single-center design supports the concept, not a definitive standard.

items.title: Trends in Patient Profile and Surgical Preferences for Breast Augmentation in China: A Retrospective Cohort Study Before and After the COVID-19 Era
items.fact_zh: 682例中国隆胸：疫后更年长、假体更大（262.7对253.2cc）、圆型51.8%，满意度反降。
items.take_zh: 客人更懂、更敢花钱，不等于更满意；咨询重点从“做大”转到术后预期和长期形态。
items.scene_zh: 现在客人来了直接报型号，先别顺着加，问问她术后想看到什么。
items.fact_en: In 682 Chinese augmentation patients, the post-pandemic cohort was older, chose larger (262.7 vs 253.2 cc) and more round implants (51.8% vs 34.9%), yet breast satisfaction declined.
items.take_en: Better-informed, higher-spending patients are not more satisfied; shift counseling from size to expectations and long-term shape.

items.journal: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
items.title: Holidays With Perks: A Registry-based Study Investigating Revision Procedures Among Patients With Breast Implants Inserted Overseas
items.fact_zh: 30,579例假体翻修中11.7%为境外植入；境外组破裂27.0%、移位24.9%，均高于境内。
items.take_zh: 低价旅行隆胸的账最后算在翻修和公立医院上；接诊先问植入地、假体型号和原始记录。
items.scene_zh: 哪儿做的？什么牌子？有没有原始病历？先问这三句。
items.fact_en: Of 30,579 breast implant revisions, 11.7% involved overseas-inserted devices, with higher rupture (27.0% vs 24.5%) and malposition (24.9% vs 20.5%).
items.take_en: Cosmetic tourism shifts costs to revision surgery and public hospitals; ask overseas patients for implant records before planning.
